summary: Official Government of Assam Bhunaksha discovery and public backend inspection identified a local/state cadastral service. Kamarkuchi was resolved to village code 240105030310010 under Kamrup Mahanagar and Sonapur, and one bounded parcel response supplied stable native IDs and EPSG:32646 geometry. Runtime remains held pending independent serial qualification.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, route bodies/statuses, schema/CRS findings and limits are recorded in city-11939-kamarkuchi.json. Scratch response evidence is under tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/11939/.

scopeLimits: No exact-point hit or miss was used as citywide evidence.
One village and one DAG response is not citywide coverage.
Jamabandi CAPTCHA/login surfaces were not bypassed.
No unsafe personal, ownership, title, address, contact, tax or account fields were requested or retained.
No certificate exception or credential/private token was used.
Completion means research packet complete, not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: The WUP point may not correspond to the returned Kamarkuchi village extent.
Geometry was observed but not retained as a cohort sample because no normalized GeoJSON sample was necessary for this attempt.
doNotInfer: A bounded anonymous response is not proof of citywide completeness.
A CAPTCHA or unusable UI is not evidence of parcel absence.
A local registry service does not imply source integration is complete.
